set.body: Add an explicit runtime-rank Zarr hierarchy model and lower supported Zarr v2 array/group metadata into the existing shared ArrayDescriptor rather than creating a parallel reader. Support root and nested node discovery from explicit keys, v3 consolidated inline metadata, and v2 .zmetadata as bounded optional indexes; absence of consolidation must remain lawful. Preserve store capability honesty: navigation may use explicit paths without listing, while discovery requires a bounded list capability. V2 scope is read-only simple fixed-width numeric/bool dtypes, C/F order lowered through bytes/transpose, regular chunks, dot/slash chunk keys, fill values, and the already executable compressor subset; structured/object/variable strings and unsupported filters refuse explicitly. Gates: v2/v3 hierarchy equivalence, implicit v2 groups, stale/malformed consolidated metadata refusal or safe fallback per contract, scalar/rank-five arrays, JVM/Scala.js fixtures, and Zarr-Python differential reads. No v2 writer and no NeuroArchive policy in core.
set.title: Zarr Z8.2: hierarchy navigation and v2/consolidated metadata lowering
